mapper.sql: (SELECT pc2.car_image_url FROM platform_car pc2 LEFT JOIN cz_platform_priority pp ON pp.platform_name = pc2.platform_name WHERE pc2.car_id = cm.car_id AND pc2.car_image_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IFNULL(pc2.car_image_url,'')) != '' ORDER BY pp.priority ASC LIMIT 1)
mapper.select:
SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, (SELECT MAKER_NAME FROM CZ_MAKER Z WHERE CM.MAKER_CODE = Z.MAKER_CODE) MAKER_NAME, (SELECT MODEL_NAME FROM CZ_MODEL Z WHERE CM.MODEL_CODE = Z.MODEL_CODE) MODEL_NAME, (SELECT TRIM_NAME FROM CZ_TRIM Z WHERE CM.TRIM_CODE = Z.TRIM_CODE) TRIM_NAME, cm.year AS year, cm.mileage AS km, MIN(pc.price) AS priceMin, MAX(pc.price) AS priceMax, MAX(pc.updated_at) AS priceUpdatedAt, AS representativeImageUrl, cm.MODEL_CODE, COALESCE(MAX(pc.fuel), cm.fuel) AS fuel, COALESCE(MAX(pc.region), cm.region) AS region FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id
GROUP BY cm.car_id
ORDER BY priceMin ASC ORDER BY km ASC ORDER BY year DESC ORDER BY priceUpdatedAt DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cm.car_id) FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id

SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, pc.maker_name, pc.model_group_name, pc.model_name, pc.trim_name, cm.year, cm.mileage, cm.displacement, COALESCE(pc.fuel, cm.fuel) AS fuel, COALESCE(pc.transmission, cm.transmission) AS transmission, COALESCE(pc.color, cm.color) AS color, COALESCE(pc.body_type, cm.body_type) AS body_type, COALESCE(pc.region, cm.region) AS region, COALESCE(pc.seat_count, cm.seat_count) AS seatCount, cm.my_accident_cnt AS myAccidentCnt, pc.platform_car_id AS platformCarId, pc.platform_name, pc.price, pc.status, pc.pc_url, pc.m_url, DATE_FORMAT(pc.last_seen_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastSeenDate, pc.car_image_url AS representativeImageUrl FROM car_master cm INNER JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id LEFT JOIN cz_platform_priority pp ON pp.platform_name = pc.platform_name WHERE cm.car_id = #{carId} ORDER BY pc.price ASC, COALESCE(pp.priority, 999) ASC
SELECT pc_url AS pcUrl, m_url AS mUrl FROM platform_car WHERE car_id = #{carId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT car_id AS carId, model_code AS modelCode FROM car_master
car_id IN #{id}

SELECT pc2.car_image_url FROM platform_car pc2 LEFT JOIN cz_platform_priority pp ON pp.platform_name = pc2.platform_name WHERE pc2.car_id = #{carId} AND pc2.car_image_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IFNULL(pc2.car_image_url,'')) != '' ORDER BY COALESCE(pp.priority, 999) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT pc.platform_car_id FROM platform_car pc WHERE pc.car_id = #{carId} ORDER BY pc.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT checked_at AS ts, price FROM car_price_history WHERE platform_car_id = #{platformCarId} ORDER BY checked_at ASC
SELECT image_url AS imageUrl, is_main AS isMain, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM cz_model_image WHERE model_code = #{modelCode} ORDER BY is_main DESC, sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT m.maker_code AS code, m.maker_name AS name, IFNULL(m.country_code, '') AS countryCode, CASE WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(m.country_code, '')) IN ('KR', 'KOR', 'KO') THEN 1 WHEN IFNULL(m.country_code, '') = '국산' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS domestic, 0 AS carCount FROM cz_maker m ORDER BY domestic DESC, m.maker_name ASC

SELECT bt.code AS code, bt.name AS name, 0 AS carCount FROM ( SELECT '경차' AS code, '경차' AS name UNION ALL SELECT '소형', '소형' UNION ALL SELECT '준중형', '준중형' UNION ALL SELECT '중형', '중형' UNION ALL SELECT '대형', '대형' UNION ALL SELECT 'SUV', 'SUV' UNION ALL SELECT 'RV', 'RV' UNION ALL SELECT '승합', '승합' UNION ALL SELECT '스포츠카', '스포츠카' UNION ALL SELECT '트럭', '트럭' UNION ALL SELECT '화물', '화물' UNION ALL SELECT '상용', '상용' UNION ALL SELECT '기타', '기타' ) bt ORDER BY FIELD(bt.code, '경차','소형','준중형','중형','대형','SUV','RV','승합','스포츠카','트럭','화물','상용','기타')
SELECT mg.model_group_code AS code, mg.model_group_name AS name, 0 AS carCount FROM cz_model_group mg WHERE mg.maker_code = #{makerCode} ORDER BY mg.model_group_name
SELECT mo.model_code AS code, mo.model_name AS name, 0 AS carCount FROM cz_model mo WHERE mo.maker_code = #{makerCode} AND mo.model_group_code = #{modelGroupCode} ORDER BY mo.model_name

SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, cm.maker_code AS makerCode, cm.model_group_code AS modelGroupCode, cm.model_code AS modelCode, cm.trim_code AS trimCode, cm.grade_code AS gradeCode, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(m.maker_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pc.maker_name)), '')) AS makerName, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(mg.model_group_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pc.model_group_name)), '')) AS modelGroupName, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(mo.model_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pc.model_name)), '')) AS modelName, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(t.trim_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pc.trim_name)), '')) AS trimName, cm.year AS year, cm.mileage AS km, MIN(pc.price) AS priceMin, MAX(pc.price) AS priceMax, MAX(pc.updated_at) AS priceUpdatedAt, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.platform_name) AS platformCount, COALESCE(MAX(pc.fuel), cm.fuel) AS fuel, COALESCE(MAX(pc.transmission), cm.transmission) AS transmission, COALESCE(MAX(pc.color), cm.color) AS color, COALESCE(MAX(pc.body_type), cm.body_type) AS bodyType, COALESCE(MAX(pc.region), cm.region) AS region, cm.car_no AS carNo, MAX(CASE WHEN pc.car_image_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IFNULL(pc.car_image_url,'')) != '' THEN pc.car_image_url ELSE NULL END) AS representativeImageUrl FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id AND ( pc.status = 'ONSALE' OR (pc.platform_name IN ('ENCAR', 'ENCAR_TRUCK') AND pc.status = 'ADVERTISE') ) LEFT JOIN cz_maker m ON m.maker_code = cm.maker_code LEFT JOIN cz_model_group mg ON mg.maker_code = cm.maker_code AND mg.model_group_code = cm.model_group_code LEFT JOIN cz_model mo ON mo.maker_code = cm.maker_code AND mo.model_group_code = cm.model_group_code AND mo.model_code = cm.model_code LEFT JOIN cz_trim t ON t.maker_code = cm.maker_code AND t.model_group_code = cm.model_group_code AND t.model_code = cm.model_code AND t.trim_code = cm.trim_code WHERE cm.adv_status = 'ONSALE' AND cm.car_id > #{lastCarId} GROUP BY cm.car_id, cm.maker_code, cm.model_group_code, cm.model_code, cm.trim_code, cm.grade_code, cm.year, cm.mileage, cm.fuel, cm.transmission, cm.color, cm.body_type, cm.region, cm.car_no, m.maker_name, mo.model_name, t.trim_name HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN pc.car_image_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IFNULL(pc.car_image_url,'')) != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 ORDER BY cm.car_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, cm.maker_code AS makerCode, cm.model_group_code AS modelGroupCode, cm.model_code AS modelCode, cm.trim_code AS trimCode, cm.grade_code AS gradeCode, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(m.maker_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pc.maker_name)), '')) AS makerName, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(mg.model_group_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pc.model_group_name)), '')) AS modelGroupName, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(mo.model_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pc.model_name)), '')) AS modelName, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(t.trim_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pc.trim_name)), '')) AS trimName, cm.year AS year, cm.mileage AS km, MIN(pc.price) AS priceMin, MAX(pc.price) AS priceMax, MAX(pc.updated_at) AS priceUpdatedAt, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.platform_name) AS platformCount, COALESCE(MAX(pc.fuel), cm.fuel) AS fuel, COALESCE(MAX(pc.transmission), cm.transmission) AS transmission, COALESCE(MAX(pc.color), cm.color) AS color, COALESCE(MAX(pc.body_type), cm.body_type) AS bodyType, COALESCE(MAX(pc.region), cm.region) AS region, cm.car_no AS carNo, MAX(CASE WHEN pc.car_image_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IFNULL(pc.car_image_url,'')) != '' THEN pc.car_image_url ELSE NULL END) AS representativeImageUrl FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id AND ( pc.status = 'ONSALE' OR (pc.platform_name IN ('ENCAR', 'ENCAR_TRUCK') AND pc.status = 'ADVERTISE') ) LEFT JOIN cz_maker m ON m.maker_code = cm.maker_code LEFT JOIN cz_model_group mg ON mg.maker_code = cm.maker_code AND mg.model_group_code = cm.model_group_code LEFT JOIN cz_model mo ON mo.maker_code = cm.maker_code AND mo.model_group_code = cm.model_group_code AND mo.model_code = cm.model_code LEFT JOIN cz_trim t ON t.maker_code = cm.maker_code AND t.model_group_code = cm.model_group_code AND t.model_code = cm.model_code AND t.trim_code = cm.trim_code WHERE cm.adv_status = 'ONSALE' AND cm.car_id > #{lastCarId} GROUP BY cm.car_id, cm.maker_code, cm.model_group_code, cm.model_code, cm.trim_code, cm.grade_code, cm.year, cm.mileage, cm.fuel, cm.transmission, cm.color, cm.body_type, cm.region, cm.car_no, m.maker_name, mo.model_name, t.trim_name HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN pc.car_image_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IFNULL(pc.car_image_url,'')) != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 ORDER BY cm.car_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, cm.maker_code AS makerCode, cm.model_group_code AS modelGroupCode, cm.model_code AS modelCode, cm.trim_code AS trimCode, cm.grade_code AS gradeCode, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(m.maker_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pc.maker_name)), '')) AS makerName, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(mg.model_group_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pc.model_group_name)), '')) AS modelGroupName, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(mo.model_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pc.model_name)), '')) AS modelName, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(t.trim_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pc.trim_name)), '')) AS trimName, cm.year AS year, cm.mileage AS km, MIN(pc.price) AS priceMin, MAX(pc.price) AS priceMax, MAX(pc.updated_at) AS priceUpdatedAt, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.platform_name) AS platformCount, COALESCE(MAX(pc.fuel), cm.fuel) AS fuel, COALESCE(MAX(pc.transmission), cm.transmission) AS transmission, COALESCE(MAX(pc.color), cm.color) AS color, COALESCE(MAX(pc.body_type), cm.body_type) AS bodyType, COALESCE(MAX(pc.region), cm.region) AS region, cm.car_no AS carNo, MAX(CASE WHEN pc.car_image_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IFNULL(pc.car_image_url,'')) != '' THEN pc.car_image_url ELSE NULL END) AS representativeImageUrl FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id AND ( pc.status = 'ONSALE' OR (pc.platform_name IN ('ENCAR', 'ENCAR_TRUCK') AND pc.status = 'ADVERTISE') ) LEFT JOIN cz_maker m ON m.maker_code = cm.maker_code LEFT JOIN cz_model_group mg ON mg.maker_code = cm.maker_code AND mg.model_group_code = cm.model_group_code LEFT JOIN cz_model mo ON mo.maker_code = cm.maker_code AND mo.model_group_code = cm.model_group_code AND mo.model_code = cm.model_code LEFT JOIN cz_trim t ON t.maker_code = cm.maker_code AND t.model_group_code = cm.model_group_code AND t.model_code = cm.model_code AND t.trim_code = cm.trim_code WHERE cm.adv_status = 'ONSALE' AND cm.updated_at >= #{updatedSince} AND cm.car_id > #{lastCarId} GROUP BY cm.car_id, cm.maker_code, cm.model_group_code, cm.model_code, cm.trim_code, cm.grade_code, cm.year, cm.mileage, cm.fuel, cm.transmission, cm.color, cm.body_type, cm.region, cm.car_no, m.maker_name, mo.model_name, t.trim_name HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN pc.car_image_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IFNULL(pc.car_image_url,'')) != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 ORDER BY cm.car_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, cm.maker_code AS makerCode, cm.model_group_code AS modelGroupCode, cm.model_code AS modelCode, cm.trim_code AS trimCode, cm.grade_code AS gradeCode, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(m.maker_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pc.maker_name)), '')) AS makerName, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(mg.model_group_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pc.model_group_name)), '')) AS modelGroupName, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(mo.model_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pc.model_name)), '')) AS modelName, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(t.trim_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pc.trim_name)), '')) AS trimName, cm.year AS year, cm.mileage AS km, MIN(pc.price) AS priceMin, MAX(pc.price) AS priceMax, MAX(pc.updated_at) AS priceUpdatedAt, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.platform_name) AS platformCount, COALESCE(MAX(pc.fuel), cm.fuel) AS fuel, COALESCE(MAX(pc.transmission), cm.transmission) AS transmission, COALESCE(MAX(pc.color), cm.color) AS color, COALESCE(MAX(pc.body_type), cm.body_type) AS bodyType, COALESCE(MAX(pc.region), cm.region) AS region, COALESCE(MAX(pc.option_array), '') AS optionArray, COALESCE(MAX(pc.sel_option_array), '') AS selOptionArray, cm.car_no AS carNo, MAX(img.representativeImageUrl) AS representativeImageUrl FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id LEFT JOIN cz_maker m ON m.maker_code = cm.maker_code LEFT JOIN cz_model_group mg ON mg.maker_code = cm.maker_code AND mg.model_group_code = cm.model_group_code LEFT JOIN cz_model mo ON mo.maker_code = cm.maker_code AND mo.model_group_code = cm.model_group_code AND mo.model_code = cm.model_code LEFT JOIN cz_trim t ON t.maker_code = cm.maker_code AND t.model_group_code = cm.model_group_code AND t.model_code = cm.model_code AND t.trim_code = cm.trim_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT car_id, car_image_url AS representativeImageUrl FROM ( SELECT pc2.car_id, pc2.car_image_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pc2.car_id ORDER BY COALESCE(pp.priority, 999) ASC) rn FROM platform_car pc2 LEFT JOIN cz_platform_priority pp ON pp.platform_name = pc2.platform_name WHERE pc2.car_image_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IFNULL(pc2.car_image_url,'')) != '' ) x WHERE rn = 1 ) img ON img.car_id = cm.car_id WHERE cm.car_id = #{carId} GROUP BY cm.car_id, cm.maker_code, cm.model_group_code, cm.model_code, cm.trim_code, cm.grade_code, cm.year, cm.mileage, cm.fuel, cm.transmission, cm.color, cm.body_type, cm.region, cm.car_no, m.maker_name, mo.model_name, t.trim_name LIMIT 1
